name: Ward nurse, engaged participant
answers: I am a nurse on the surgical ward, I look after eight patients per shift and coordinate with the doctors and the lab.
Mornings are rounds and medication, then charting in two systems, then calls to the lab for results.
Charting is the same every day, about 45 minutes, in the patient system and again in the ward spreadsheet.
We use the patient system, a ward Excel file, and WhatsApp for quick questions to doctors.
Results from the lab come by phone, then I type them into the system by hand.
I wait for the lab most days, sometimes an hour, and the doctors wait for me.
The double entry causes mistakes, and nobody knows which number is right.
I would stop the double entry first.
